pages.title: Dawn Bloom
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r I$(br2)§lApplies to: §r Sword of the Free Will, Sword of the Free Will · Eternal Spark$(br2)§lEffect: §r Sword aura damage is raised from 100% to 350% (an extra +250%).$(br2)§lObtaining: §r Enchanting Table, loot chests, villager trades.$(br2)Only works on the Sword of the Free Will line.
